tools.name: search_films_by_description
tools.description: Use when the user describes a film's plot, scenes, mood or theme — or half-remembers a film — and wants matching titles. Works in English, Ukrainian, Russian and Polish (set `language` to the user's language). Put every explicit constraint the user stated into the structured fields — year_from, year

tools.name: what_to_watch_tonight
tools.description: Suggest three to five films to watch tonight from World of Cine's catalogue, each with a one-line reason and its film-page link. tools.name: film_details
tools.description: Use when the user names a specific film (slug or title) and wants its card. Returns title, year, director, genres, a description excerpt in the requested language with its attribution, and the film's World of Cine link, which should be shown to the user.

tools.name: rate_recommendation
tools.description: Use when the user has said whether a World of Cine recommendation helped. Call it only after the user says so, once per recommendation_id. Feedback is analytics only and never changes the catalogue.

description: Films from World of Cine's catalogue that are legally free to watch, each naming its proof: a public-domain statement with the jurisdiction it holds in, or a free-licensed copy on Wikimedia Commons. findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_films_by_description" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
